ThinkByte: Niharika Chavati, Vamsi posimsetti, Anupam Gevariya, Yash Mori, Krishna Sindhur, Shivani Singamsetty, vinay kovvuri, Praneetaa Lakshmi, Abhilash Gedela
Key Takeaways
The team is building an SEO platform that automates manual tasks like keyword universe creation and content generation using AI agents and workflows.
The platform will have three layers: a front-end layer, a back-end layer using Django, and an AI layer with agents built using LangGraph and FastAPI.
Infrastructure will be deployed on Kubernetes with multi-regional availability, using AWS services like ECR for container images and Route 53 for traffic routing.
The team is behind schedule on project setup, with a goal to start coding soon and have the first version ready by January.
Team members are assigned specific roles, with Anupam and Vamsi focusing on the back-end and AI parts, while Niharika and Mars work on the front-end.
